reuse.why: Uses link.findOrCreateBank, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse and db.updateAccount, and adds one shared link guard used by all providers, but the takeover re-writes unlinkAccount's field reset and Fintegra re-writes the link sequence and the Akahu download instead of factoring them.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a sixth copy of the upgrade/insert/sync/sync-event sequence, downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, and the unlink field reset copies unlinkAccount's updateAccount block.

placement.why: Guards live in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers, the download in sync.ts with the other providers, and the server path in server-config, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Changes stay on linking, the new provider and tests; the closed-account check is folded into the link-uniqueness guard rather than called separately, but nothing unrelated is touched.

maintainability.why: The single guard keeps the link rules in one place, but it is misnamed (ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked also checks closed accounts and can unlink another account), and the duplicated link sequence and unlink reset will drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked clears the old account's bank fields with its own db.updateAccount instead of sharing unlinkAccount's reset logic.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount compresses the provider link sequence into one-line ifs and inline payee insert; downloadFintegraTransactions is Akahu's download with the 'error' branch and logging trimmed.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gains the replaceExistingLink flag and a branch that unlinks the existing account (a side effect inside an 'ensure' guard), and also absorbs the closed-account check; all six link handlers call it.
